background_sample.hash: SHA256(salt + newline + document_id); first 8 hex digits interpreted unsigned; < floor(2^32*basis_points/10000)

known_gaps: Consumer-demand and retail-sales release coverage is not verified as comprehensive.
No issuer membership, issuer materiality, earnings-surprise or expectation-outcome classifier.
No verified complete treatment of reopening, nascent shocks or missing topic tags.
No proof that co-occurring features describe the same event.
Published code existence does not establish an exact current production tagging rule.
normalization: Unicode NFKC casefold; whitespace collapse; trim; distinct complete labels
purpose: Prioritize candidates for S&P 500 situation-similarity indexing; preserve compact metadata and an unbiased monitoring sample.

rules.label: Monetary policy and inflation
rules.rationale: Potential discount-rate, financing-cost and inflation channel; no directional inference.

rules.label: Growth, labor, housing and living costs
rules.rationale: Potential aggregate demand and earnings channel; national scale is not established by the tag.

rules.label: Fiscal policy and public finance
rules.rationale: Potential spending, taxation and sovereign-financing channel; local and routine news may match.

rules.label: Trade policy and foreign exchange
rules.rationale: Potential trade, input-cost and international earnings channel.

rules.label: Capital markets and earnings reports
rules.rationale: Useful financial-topic candidates; does not establish issuer size, surprise or advance information.

rules.label: Financial stability and sovereign stress
rules.rationale: Potential credit and financial-system channel; a topic mention is not proof of stress.

rules.label: Energy prices and policy
rules.rationale: Potential energy-cost and inflation channel; includes policy change in either direction.

rules.label: Sanctions, blockades and ceasefires
rules.rationale: Broad geopolitical topics with plausible transmission; scope and actual occurrence require review.

rules.label: Pandemic topics
rules.rationale: Broad systemic-health fallback without requiring an economic tag; misses some emerging unlabeled threats.

rules.label: Insolvency with banking context
rules.rationale: Same-article conjunction; does not establish a confirmed bank failure.

rules.label: Conflict or recovery with energy or logistics
rules.rationale: Includes reconstruction and negotiation; co-occurrence does not prove a semantic connection.

rules.label: Labor disruption with an industrial system
rules.rationale: Potential production or transport channel; story scale remains unmeasured.

rules.label: Infrastructure disruption or recovery with a system
rules.rationale: The infrastructure family can cover restored services as well as damage.

rules.label: Politics or uncertainty with economic context
rules.rationale: Requires economic context; political names alone are not predicates.

rules.label: General policy with an economic system
rules.rationale: Broad regulatory/operational channel; not a formal economic-policy-uncertainty measure.

rules.label: Broader economic and system context
rules.rationale: Broad sensitivity profile; deliberately includes routine sector coverage.

rules.label: Disruption and recovery without channel tag
rules.rationale: Broad sensitivity profile; protects some missing-channel cases but can admit local/historical stories.

unmatched_policy: Retain compact metadata. Eligible for the deterministic background sample; no claim of irrelevance.
